title: Pakistan Cables recognised at Int’l Solar Technology Excellence Awards 2026
summary: LAHORE: Pakistan Cables Ltd has been recognized as the exclusive category winner for Solar DC Cables at the 3rd International Solar Technology Excellence Awards 2026, organized by Energy Updates, held recently in Lahore. The award was presented by Malik Faisal Ayub Khokhar, Provincial Minister for Energy Punjab to Qasim uz Zaman Bajwa, Senior Manager Project Sales, who received the award on behalf of Pakistan Cables. This is the second consecutive win for the Company. The recognition acknowledges the Company’s contribution to Pakistan’s growing solar energy sector through its Solar DC Cables.

title: PSO in FY26–held back by a weaker last quarter
summary: Pakistan State Oil Company Limited’s (PSX: PSO) FY26 performance was mixed. The company remained operationally resilient through a volatile year, but weaker fuel volumes, lower LNG activity and heavy inventory losses in the final quarter pulled down earnings. Net sales declined 3 percent to Rs3.05 trillion, reflecting lower MS and HSD volumes and reduced contribution from LNG. PSO’s MS and HSD volumes fell by around 5 percent and 6 percent, respectively, year-on-year, while its market share slipped to around 42-43 percent as smaller OMCs gained ground.
